control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action - critical safeguard at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-9000 and TX-9001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 2 September 2012 a corrective action on SG-9000 and TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
